Diagnosis.submission: The profile service is crashing with a panic because it cannot resolve the internal Kubernetes service name mongodb-profile. The profile deployment has dnsPolicy set to None with a custom nameserver of 8.8.8.8 (Google DNS) instead of using the Kubernetes cluster DNS (ClusterFirst). Since 8.8.8.8 cannot resolve internal Kubernetes service names, the profile service fails to connect to its MongoDB database and panics with no reachable servers.
